subject: maths
question: In an election, there were 12,000 voters. In the first round, Babita received 40% of the votes, and Ramanlal received 35% of the votes. The remaining votes went to other candidates. In the second round, Babita gained 20% more votes compared to the first round, while Ramanlal gained 10% more votes. How many votes did Babita receive in the second round?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Babita first round = 40% of 12000 = 4800

Second round increase = 20% ⇒ multiply by 1.2

New votes = 4800 × 1.2

= 5760

**∴ Answer = 5760**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total voters = 12000, Babita got 40% in first round and then 20% more votes

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (part / whole) × 100 and increase = original × (1 + rate)

**Calculation:**

⇒ First round votes of Babita = 40% of 12000

⇒ = (40/100) × 12000 = 4800

⇒ Increase = 20% of 4800 = 960

⇒ Second round votes = 4800 + 960

⇒ = 5760

**∴ The correct answer is 5760.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Increase

New value = Original × (1 + increase/100)

Basic Percentage

x% of y = (x/100) × y

Successive Change

When values increase in stages, apply percentage on the latest value.

Quick Multiplier Trick

Increase by 20% ⇒ multiply by 1.2 directly.
